lib.description: Child-friendly blocks for the M5Stack Core2: the three red touch circles, shaking, vibration, beeps and big text. Made for the Devoxx4Kids ESP32 workshop.
comment.zone: Returns 1, 2 or 3 when the left, middle or right red circle under the screen is touched, otherwise 0. The circles are touch zones below the 240-pixel-high display.
comment.edge: True only at the moment a circle becomes touched, so one touch is one event even if the finger stays on it.
comment.shaken: Acceleration is about 100 when the board lies still. 140 needs a real shake.
comment.vibrate: Switches the vibration motor on and off with the setVibration block of the Devoxx4Kids MicroBlocks firmware for the Core2 (power chip AXP192, output LDO3).
comment.big_text: Clears the screen and writes the text in the middle, as big as possible: a long text is split over several lines (one letter is 6 x 8 pixels at size 1).
project.m1_done: Magic Shake Ball - finished version for coaches
comment.m1_start: Start here! Drag blocks from the Core2Buttons library under this block. Follow mission.md step by step.
project.m3_done: Emoji Messenger - finished version for coaches
comment.m3_start: Start here! Change the group number 1 to your table number. The emoji list is ready for you. Follow mission.md step by step.
comment.flash: Draws a yellow frame around the screen while a beep or buzz lasts, so children see it even when the speaker or the motor stays silent.
comment.show_bomb: Draws the bomb pictures (Noto Animated Emoji by Google, CC BY 4.0). The frames are files on the board, installed with the workshop firmware. Nervous shows the next frame each time it runs; explode and safe play their whole animation.
comment.jolt: How hard the board is moving right now: 0 when it is still, more when it is shaken. It is the distance between the acceleration and 100 (= 1 g).
comment.danger_bar: A bar along the bottom of the screen: green below 50, orange from 50, red at 100.
comment.m2_start: Start here! Carry the bomb to the safe zone without jolting it. Follow mission.md step by step.
comment.load_palette: Reads the 256 picture colours from the file bomb_palette.data on the board. Without that file the pictures stay black, but the program keeps running.
comment.wrap: Splits a text into lines of at most the given number of characters, at the spaces between words.
